explanation: Both V0.M1.AUX.3 violations arise because VIA_VIA12 M1 lands straddle the notch boundary of the background M1 U-shape, creating a non-coincident convex corner on the adjacent V0 std-cell pin; shifting each via +36 dbu in x moves its M1 land left edge to the V0 pin's right edge, making the entire V0 boundary edge coincident with the merged M1 boundary and eliminating the convex-corner condition.
